name: phr-dapp
description: Decentralized Personal Health Record (PHR) dApp using Ethereum and IPFS

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "CHAIN,DEPLOY,FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,yellow,green,magenta" "npm run node" "wait-on tcp:8545 && npm run deploy:local" "wait-on tcp:8545 && npm run frontend" "node backend/server.js"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
